 LYNCHBURG, Va. (WSET) — Riding a nine-game winning streak, Liberty football is nationally ranked for the first time since the 2023 season.
 The Flames are No. 22 in the latest Associated Press college football poll.
 SEE ALSO: Liberty runs past MTSU, earns ticket back to CUSA Title Game 
 Liberty defeated MTSU 28- 23 over the weekend. With the victory, the Flames clinched a spot in the 2026 Conference USA Football Championship game. 
 Liberty also stretched its win streak to nine, improving to 9-1 overall and staying on top of the Conference USA standings at 6-0 in league play. 
 Jaxsonville State, which entered the weekend tied with Liberty in the conference race, lost a last-second game at WKU, giving the Flames sole possession of first place.
 Liberty will play Western Kentucky to close out the regular season on Saturday.
 The Conference USA championship game will be played at the home of the CUSA regular-season champion on Dec. 4, with a 6 p.m. kickoff on CBS Sports Network.
